### Important Queensland Time Limits for Estate Litigation

- **Family Provision Notice:** Written notice of an intended claim must generally be given to the executor **within 6 months** of the date of death.[[1]](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/wills-estates-lawyers-ipswich/)
- **Court Filing:** A formal application to the Supreme Court of Queensland for a Family Provision Order must be filed **within 9 months** of the date of death.[[1]](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/wills-estates-lawyers-ipswich/)
